item.title: Pirates Add-On
item.creator: SNDBX
item.description:
PIRATES Add-On is here! Add to Any World!
Live the Pirate life. Explore, battle, and rule the seven seas!

- Craft, upgrade and customize your Pirate Ship
- Battle the powerful Sea Serpent Boss
- Unlock rare Loot, Treasure and powerful Items

faqEntries.heading: What is the Pirate Add-On about?
faqEntries.content: The Pirate Add-On adds a pirate adventure to your world. You can craft ships, sail across the ocean, discover pirate structures, collect treasure, fight enemies, upgrade your ship, and challenge the Sea Serpent boss.

faqEntries.heading: How do I start playing?
faqEntries.content: Start by crafting a Sloop. Use it to explore the ocean and search for structures. Loot those structures to gather materials, then upgrade your ship and prepare for tougher encounters.

faqEntries.heading: How do ships work?
faqEntries.content: Ships move across water and have different sail states. Interact with a ship to change its sails. More sail gives more speed, while less sail gives better control. Sloops turn the fastest, Brigantines are balanced, and Galleons are heavier but stronger.

faqEntries.heading: How do I shoot cannons?
faqEntries.content: Attack while controlling a ship to fire its cannons. Cannons shoot sideways from the ship, so position your ship carefully before firing.

faqEntries.heading: How do I summon the Sea Serpent?
faqEntries.content: Find the Worm Idol while exploring dungeons and structures. Use the Worm Idol to summon the Sea Serpent when you are prepared for the boss fight.

faqEntries.heading: What should I do before fighting the Sea Serpent?
faqEntries.content: Upgrade your ship, bring planks for repairs, gather good equipment, and make sure you are ready for ship combat. A stronger ship makes the fight much easier.

howToEntries.heading: Begin Your Pirate Adventure
howToEntries.content: Explore the ocean with new pirate-themed ships, structures, enemies, items, and treasures. Build your first ship, sail across the sea, loot dangerous locations, upgrade your ship, and prepare for a boss fight.

howToEntries.heading: Build Your First Ship
howToEntries.content: Craft a Sloop to start exploring. The Sloop is the easiest ship to obtain and gives you a way to travel across the ocean, search for structures, and begin collecting upgrade materials.

howToEntries.heading: Sail and Steer Ships
howToEntries.content: Use your ship to move across the water. Interact with the ship to change the sail state. Lower sails make the ship faster, while raised sails make it easier to control. Smaller ships turn faster, while larger ships are stronger but slower to steer.

howToEntries.heading: Fire the Cannons
howToEntries.content: Attack while controlling a ship to fire its side cannons. Cannons shoot from the sides of the ship, so turn your ship to line up shots against enemies, hostile ships, or the Sea Serpent boss.

howToEntries.heading: Repair Your Ship
howToEntries.content: Keep planks with you while sailing. Use planks on a damaged ship to repair it during long journeys or dangerous fights.

howToEntries.heading: Upgrade Your Ship
howToEntries.content: Use the Ship Workbench and upgrade materials to improve your ship. Progress from Sloop to Brigantine, then from Brigantine to Galleon. Larger ships are better for combat and boss preparation.
